# The portfolio's county seasons with the least May-to-August rain, and what they cost it: whether
# the driest seasons are the ones with the highest loss ratios, and the USDA's share of the whole
# market's losses it attributes to drought and heat there.
query DriestSeasons {
  a__viewLossesAndWeather(order_by: [{ seasonRainMm: asc }], limit: 15) {
    countyName
    stateAbbr
    year
    seasonRainMm
    hotDays
    lossRatio
    dryShare
    marketDryShare
    cornYield
  }
}
